title: Python ML: Bootstrap Aggregation (Bagging)
description: Bootstrap Aggregation (Bagging) is an ensemble meta-algorithm designed to improve the stability and accuracy of machine learning algorithms. It involves taking multiple random samples of the data with replacement (bootstrap) and training a model on each. The final prediction is the average of all individual predictions.
example:
# Bagging with Scikit-learn
from sklearn import datasets
from sklearn.ensemble import BaggingClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

iris = datasets.load_iris()
X, y = iris.data, iris.target

# Create a Bagging ensemble of Decision Trees
bagging = BaggingClassifier(DecisionTreeClassifier(), n_estimators=10)
bagging.fit(X, y)

print("Model Accuracy: ", bagging.score(X, y))
